company.shortDescription: Dabble is a betting app designed for today's punter.
company.description:
Dabble brings together the best of traditional wagering and modern social media.

A lightning-fast platform, built from scratch and ready to scale sets the Dabble app apart from other technology companies. Dabble will provide a platform for sports content consumers to interact, engage and share social sports experiences.
